tables.title: Table 22.1 Alternative interpretations of the expected mean squares for two-way analysis of variance of genotype × environment interaction under a random-effects vs. a mixed (genotypes random, environments fixed) model.
tables.html:
FactorDegrees of FreedomExpected Mean Squares
Random EffectsMixed Model
Environment$ N_{E} - 1 $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + n\sigma_{I}^{2} + nN_{G}\sigma_{E}^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + \frac{nN_{E}}{(N_{E} - 1)}\sigma_{I}^{2} $
Genetic$ N_{G} - 1 $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + n\sigma_{I}^{2} + nN_{E}\sigma_{G}^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + nN_{E}\sigma_{G}^{2} $
G × E$ (N_{E} - 1)(N_{G} - 1) $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + n\sigma_{I}^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + \frac{nN_{E}}{(N_{E} - 1)}\sigma_{I}^{2} $
Error$ N_{E}N_{G}(n - 1) $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} $

tables.title: Table 22.2 Partitioning of the interaction sum of squares by joint-regression analysis, under the random-effects model with a completely balanced design.
tables.html:
FactorDegrees of FreedomSums of SquaresExpected MS
Environment (E)$ N_{E} - 1 $$ nN_{G}\sum_{i}(\overline{z}_{i} - \overline{z})^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + n\sigma_{I}^{2} $
Genotype (G)$ N_{G} - 1 $$ nN_{E}\sum_{j}(\overline{z}_{j} - \overline{z})^{2} $$ +nN_{G}\sigma_{E}^{2} $
Interaction (I)$ (N_{E} - 1)(N_{G} - 1) $$ n\sum_{i,j}(\overline{z}_{ij} - \overline{z}_{i} - \overline{z}_{j} + \overline{z})^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + n\sigma_{I}^{2} $
Regression (B)$ N_{G} - 1 $$ SS_{E} \cdot \sum_{i}B_{j}^{2}/N_{G} $$ n(\sigma_{I}^{2} - \sigma_{\epsilon}^{2}) $
Residual ( \epsilon )$ (N_{E} - 2)(N_{G} - 1) $$ n\sum_{i,j}\epsilon_{ij}^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} + n\sigma_{\epsilon}^{2} $
Error (e)$ N_{E}N_{G}(n - 1) $$ \sum_{i,j,k}(z_{ijk} - \overline{z}_{ij})^{2} $$ \sigma_{e}^{2} $
Note: $ SS_{E} $ and $ E(MS_{I}) $ are, respectively, the error sum of squares and the expected inter-action mean square.
rows: Note: $ SS_{E} $ and $ E(MS_{I}) $ are, respectively, the error sum of squares and the expected inter-action mean square.
